mappings.note: What the Petroleum Conservation Research Association discourages is about using a resource judiciously. Not LO-27, because conservation rather than use is the point. Exact duplicate of an earlier item in this chapter, coded identically.
Picking out a natural resource is classification within the resource scheme. Not LO-16, because no property is compared. Exact duplicate of an earlier item in this chapter, coded identically.
Naming inexhaustible resources is the classification LO-17 states verbatim. Not LO-28, because nothing is conserved. Exact duplicate of an earlier item in this chapter, coded identically.

Calling limited resources exhaustible is the same classification from the other side. Not LO-28, no protective action being asked. Exact duplicate of an earlier item in this chapter, coded identically.
Picking the exhaustible natural resource is the classification outcome. Not LO-20, because no process is explained. Exact duplicate of an earlier item in this chapter, coded identically.
Sunlight placed among inexhaustible resources is resource classification. Not LO-28, because nothing is conserved. Exact duplicate of an earlier item in this chapter, coded identically.

Petroleum placed among exhaustible resources applies the same classification to a fossil fuel. Not LO-16, because a class rather than a property is assigned. Exact duplicate of an earlier item in this chapter, coded identically.
